governingStandard: HOEOS v2 Article 5 & G2/G5 AI Advisory Boundary

scenarios.name: AI Available & Valid Advice
scenarios.conditionDescription: Gemini/Nemotron returns structured advisory findings matching verified source.
scenarios.notes: Advisory findings successfully segregated to advisory envelope; deterministic engine outputs 100% bit-for-bit unchanged.

scenarios.name: AI Runtime Unavailable
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI service returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or ECONNREFUSED.
scenarios.notes: Deterministic pipeline operates without degradation; fail-closed isolation confirmed.

scenarios.name: AI Timeout Abort
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI request exceeds timeout threshold and is aborted via AbortController.
scenarios.notes: Timeout in advisory tier does not interrupt or delay authoritative deterministic output.

scenarios.name: AI Malformed Output
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI runtime returns corrupted JSON or non-schema payload.
scenarios.notes: Schema validation rejects malformed payload; deterministic authority protected.

scenarios.name: AI Empty Findings
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI runtime returns empty findings array [].
scenarios.notes: Empty advisory payload leaves deterministic similarity evidence fully intact.

scenarios.name: AI Conflicting Advice Invariant
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI model returns low/conflicting similarity claim against 100% deterministic duplicate.
scenarios.notes: Conflicting AI score did NOT overwrite or suppress authoritative deterministic score (100.0%).

scenarios.name: AI Unsupported Source Injection Defense
scenarios.conditionDescription: AI attempts to inject a match to an unauthorized or fabricated academic source ID.
scenarios.notes: HOEOS Rule 16 intercepted fabricated source: neutralized to UNVERIFIED_SOURCE with similarityScore=0.
